Definition: of uncertain origin; Mnason, a Christian:--Mnason.
BiblicalUsage: Mnason is an early disciple from Cyprus who opens his house to Paul and his companions on the road to Jerusalem. Luke calls him a disciple of long standing, and his hospitality carries the whole party through the last night before the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mnason's welcome is the gospel in miniature: an old disciple, a door open, and travellers kept safe for one more night.
